quotes.name: Wilson Shepard
quotes.quote: Structure is what holds when the names change. I've seen it in my own locker room — we went 0-9 before anyone counted a game, and the structure didn't wobble because the people in it kept doing their jobs. Same thing with the A's right now. Quintero sliding to first, Clark and Hernandez competing at third — that's not a rebuild, that's a system that trusts the next guy in. The record is just the wall. The hands change, but the wall doesn't move if the foundation's real. That's what I tell my guys when they start reading their own headlines: the ranking is a mirror, not a load-bearing beam. What holds is the work, day in and day out.
quotes.disp: steady, hard to shake; a real fan, plans around games; somewhat sociable; somewhat ambitious

quotes.name: Mike Paulson
quotes.quote: Look, the record is the record. Eight and one is eight and one, and nobody's giving it back because the lineup card changed. But the question of whose record it is — that's the wrong way to look at it. The architecture is the organization. The players are the load-bearing walls. You take one out, you brace it, you move on. Quintero sliding to first, Clark and Hernandez at third — that's us bracing. The wall doesn't fall because the hands change. It holds because the foundation was laid right. That's what I tell myself on the days it doesn't hold.
